answer: Commit to a hash of the receipt, reveal after the close, and let the audit compare the revealed text against the archive. For example, 200 receipts committed at 09:00 and revealed at 15:00 give reviewers six hours to run checks. Link two identities and the commit history resets, so prior clean work stops counting. The nadir for a farm is that reveal window, where an atlas of clones must fill a terrace of 200 distinct texts and no recruit grades its own auditor.
